As of December 31, 2025, borrowings under the Credit Agreement were available at variable rates based on SOFR plus 1.00 % or the bank prime rate and we currently pay a commitment fee at an annual rate of 0.10 % on the unused portion of the revolving credit facility. The applicable margins over SOFR and prime rate borrowings, along with commitment fees, are subject to adjustment every quarter based on our total net leverage ratio, as defined in the Credit Agreement. All borrowings under the Credit Agreement may be prepaid without penalty.

credit_strengths.text: Reliance carries gross leverage well below the Industrials sector median and net leverage likewise sits under the peer median, so the balance sheet is conservatively positioned for a metals service center. The indicative financial risk profile lands in the minimal band, supported by both leverage and cash-flow measures.

Interest coverage is far above the sector median and comfortably clears unity, reflecting modest absolute interest expense against operating income. Liquidity is also strong, with the current ratio several times the peer median and a large cushion of current assets over current liabilities.

key_risks.text: The debt note shows the revolver and term loan were drawn during the year while the low-coupon notes were repaid, lifting the weighted average effective rate. Refinancing the term loan and revolver at variable SOFR-based pricing exposes debt service to rate resets, and the margin steps with net leverage.

Disclosed risk factors flag metals pricing, tariffs and trade policy, slowing growth and recession as drivers of demand and margin volatility for this cyclical distributor. Operating margin already trails the sector median and weakened year over year, so a demand downturn would compress the earnings base supporting coverage.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Operating cash flow covers buybacks on a deterministic basis, but free cash flow falls short of buybacks, meaning distributions are partly funded from other sources. Cash conversion weakened sharply year over year, with operating cash flow and free cash flow to debt both down versus the prior year.

Cash-flow coverage of debt remains above the sector median and clears the next risk-band boundary, giving headroom before a downgrade in the indicative profile. The maturity ladder is light near term, with the bulk of principal falling in later years, limiting refinancing pressure.

overall_credit_view.text: We view Reliance as a conservatively financed, cyclical metals distributor with minimal indicative financial risk. Leverage is low against peers and coverage is strong, but the trend is adverse: leverage rose year over year and cash generation fell, so the cushion, while ample, is narrowing.

Our forward view is that coverage and liquidity should remain adequate through a moderate demand slowdown, though shareholder returns absorbing free cash flow and variable-rate borrowings are the key sensitivities. We would monitor margin compression and any further draw on the revolver as early warning signals.

credit_strengths.text: Reliance 的總槓桿遠低於工業行業中位數，淨槓桿亦低於同業中位數，因此對於一家金屬服務中心而言，其資產負債表處於保守定位。指示性財務風險狀況落在最低區間，並同時獲得槓桿及現金流指標支持。
利息覆蓋率遠高於行業中位數，並穩妥地高於一，反映絕對利息支出相對於營業收入而言適中。流動性亦強，流動比率為同業中位數的數倍，且流動資產相對流動負債有龐大緩衝。

key_risks.text: 債務附註顯示，循環信貸及定期貸款於年內被提取，而低息票據則已償還，推高了加權平均實際利率。以基於 SOFR 的浮動定價為定期貸款及循環信貸再融資，使債務償付暴露於利率重設風險，且息差會隨淨槓桿分級調整。
已披露的風險因素指出，金屬價格、關稅及貿易政策、增長放緩及衰退，是這家週期性分銷商需求及利潤率波動的驅動因素。營業利潤率已落後於行業中位數，並按年轉弱，因此需求下滑將壓縮支撐覆蓋率的盈利基礎。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 在確定性基礎上，經營現金流可覆蓋回購，但自由現金流不足以覆蓋回購，意味著分派部分由其他來源提供資金。現金轉換按年大幅轉弱，經營現金流及自由現金流對債務比率均較上一年度下降。
現金流對債務的覆蓋率仍高於行業中位數，並越過下一個風險區間界限，在指示性狀況下調前提供緩衝空間。短期到期結構較輕，大部分本金於較後年份到期，限制了再融資壓力。

overall_credit_view.text: 我們將 Reliance 視為一家融資保守的週期性金屬分銷商，指示性財務風險極低。槓桿相對同業偏低，覆蓋率強勁，但趨勢不利：槓桿按年上升，現金生成下降，因此緩衝雖仍充裕，但正在收窄。
我們的前瞻觀點是，覆蓋率及流動性應可在溫和的需求放緩中保持充足，惟股東回報吸收自由現金流及浮動利率借款是主要敏感因素。我們會監察利潤率壓縮及循環信貸的任何進一步提取，作為早期預警信號。
